# Requirements-Quality Checklist: Login & Session Management (Fase 3)

**Purpose**: "Unit Tests for English" — validate the *requirements themselves* (not the implementation) for completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, and coverage before plan/tasks proceed.
**Created**: 2026-08-31
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)
**Focus**: general | **Depth**: Standard | **Audience**: Reviewer (PR)
**Relevance clusters**: (1) Auth/session lifecycle requirements, (2) Error contract & non-revealing requirements

**Note**: Generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command. Each item interrogates the *requirement quality* (does the spec say what is needed, clearly, consistently, measurably?) — not whether the implementation behaves correctly. References are to `spec.md` sections unless noted.

---

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all PRD acceptance criteria in scope (AC-004, AC-005, AC-006, AC-009) explicitly mapped to at least one functional requirement AND at least one acceptance scenario? [Completeness, Spec §Input/§Requirements]
- [ ] CHK002 Is every functional requirement (FR-001..FR-023) traced to at least one acceptance scenario or success criterion, so no requirement is orphaned? [Completeness, Spec §Requirements/§Success Criteria]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements specified for each distinct session-lifecycle state — creation, validation, expiration, and revocation — as separate, individually testable rules? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004/FR-006/FR-007/FR-013]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the set of protected endpoints AND the set of unprotected endpoints (face-login, onboarding) both enumerated exhaustively, so the protection boundary is closed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the response shape specified for every auth endpoint (face-login, me, logout) on BOTH success and every documented failure path? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005/FR-011/FR-012]
- [ ] CHK006 Is "a valid session" defined in if-and-only-if terms (row exists, revokedAt null, expiresAt future) so the invalid complement is unambiguous? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006/§Key Entities]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is the "non-revealing" requirement quantified with a specific, testable criterion (byte-identical status + machine code + message for the two identity-sensitive causes) rather than left as "generic"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008/SC-003]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "actionable" error message defined with concrete characteristics (tells the person how to recapture/retry, reveals no internals) rather than used as a qualitative adjective? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009/FR-015]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the verification threshold's unit (cosine similarity) and comparison operator (`>=`) stated explicitly so the acceptance boundary is unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002/FR-003]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "keyboard-accessible" given a measurable definition (e.g. reachable via Tab, descriptive accessible name) rather than left to reviewer judgment? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017/FR-018]
- [ ] CHK011 Are the machine error codes enumerated as a closed set (`auth_failed`, `unauthenticated`, `no_face`, `multiple_faces`, `invalid_image`, `insufficient_quality`, `internal_error`) so no undocumented code can appear? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009/FR-010]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the identifier normalization rule stated as an explicit ordered sequence (trim then lowercase) rather than "normalized"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK013 Are the HTTP status-code assignments consistent across FR-008 (401 auth_failed), FR-010 (400 capture codes), and the Assumptions status-mapping table? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008/FR-010/§Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the error body shape (`{"error":{"code","message"}}`) consistent with the spec-002-pinned shape referenced in Clarifications and FR-009? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009/§Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK015 Are the session-validity rules stated identically in FR-006, the AuthSession entity definition, and the edge cases (no drift between the three)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006/§Key Entities/§Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the "no single-session constraint" (multiple concurrent sessions allowed) stated consistently in Clarifications, Edge Cases, and Assumptions? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications/§Edge Cases/§Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the default 30-minute session lifetime consistent across FR-007, the Clarifications, and the AuthSession entity definition? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007/§Clarifications/§Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the failure-evaluation ordering stated consistently between the Clarifications and the Assumptions (same step sequence)? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications/§Assumptions]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK019 Does each acceptance scenario state a complete Given/When/Then with measurable assertions (status codes, body fields, DB row properties) rather than prose? [Measurability, Spec §User Stories]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the non-revealing acceptance scenario expressed as a byte-identical full-response comparison, not "similar" or "the same error"? [Measurability, Spec §Story 2 scenario 1/SC-003]
- [ ] CHK021 Does every success criterion (SC-001..SC-013) include an explicit verification method? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [ ] CHK022 Are negative acceptance scenarios ("no AuthSession created") stated for EVERY failure cause (nonexistent identifier, below-threshold, no face, multiple faces, undecodable image, port error)? [Measurability, Spec §Story 2/SC-004]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK023 Are scenarios defined for re-login while a prior session is valid AND for concurrent successful logins producing two independent sessions? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases/§Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK024 Is a scenario defined for each session-invalidity cause on protected endpoints — expired, revoked, unknown id, absent cookie, tampered cookie, out-of-band-deleted row? [Coverage, Spec §Story 3/§Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK025 Is a scenario defined for embedding-dimension mismatch returning `internal_error` (no meaningless score)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK026 Is a scenario defined for detector/embedder port errors during login returning a recoverable error with no partial session persisted? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK027 Is a scenario defined for database unavailability at session-creation time after successful verification (no AuthSession committed, retryable)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK028 Is a scenario defined for runtime threshold change via env var affecting only subsequent logins (existing sessions unaffected)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK029 Is logout idempotence specified across all input states (no cookie, expired, revoked, valid) with the same success body? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases/FR-012]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK030 Is the identifier-exists-but-no-FaceTemplate invariant violation specified as a defensive `auth_failed` (not an expected state)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK031 Is the residual identifier-existence leak (capture error for existing identifier vs. `auth_failed` for nonexistent) explicitly acknowledged as a documented demo limitation under Principle VIII, rather than left implicit? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases/§Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK032 Is an edge case defined for the camera stream ending mid-capture yielding a recoverable UI state with retry? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK033 Is a non-functional requirement stated prohibiting images, embeddings, or biometric responses in logs, AND limiting observability to structured JSON logs (operation duration/type/status)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-023/SC-013]
- [ ] CHK034 Is a non-functional requirement stated for domain isolation — login/session orchestration depends only on ports, with zero concrete ML/web/infra adapter imports? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021/SC-009]
- [ ] CHK035 Is a non-functional requirement stated that the domain test suite runs without GPU, network, or real models? [Completeness, Spec §FR-022/SC-010]
- [ ] CHK036 Is the performance bound (SC-001 "under 30 seconds") qualified to a stated environment and scope (excluding camera-permission time, local demo), so it is not over-claimed as an SLO? [Completeness, Spec §SC-001/§Assumptions]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK037 Are the dependencies on specs 001 and 002 (entities, ports, contracts, migrations, mock adapters, image limits, error-body shape) explicitly enumerated rather than implicit? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK038 Is the constitution-pinned technology stack (Principle III/IV/VI, OQ-3/OQ-6/OQ-8) referenced as settled project-level decisions rather than re-decided at the spec layer? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions/Constitution §III]
- [ ] CHK039 Is the secure-context assumption (localhost or HTTPS) for browser camera access explicitly stated? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK040 Is the cookie signing key provenance (env var, demo default) stated, with key rotation/secure-key management explicitly out of scope under Principle VIII? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK041 Does any requirement assert a security property beyond demo-best-effort that conflicts with Constitution Principle VIII (no security guarantee), and if so is it explicitly justified? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008/Constitution §VIII]
- [ ] CHK042 Are "actionable" (FR-009/FR-010/FR-015) and "recoverable" (Edge Cases/FR-017) used as distinct, defined terms or are they synonymous — is the relationship stated to prevent reviewer divergence? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-009/FR-010/FR-015/FR-017]
- [ ] CHK043 Is the tension between the failure-evaluation ordering (capture errors surface only for existing identifiers) and the non-revealing requirement explicitly reconciled and documented as an accepted trade-off? [Ambiguity, Spec §Clarifications/§Assumptions/§Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK044 Is "demo-first" applied consistently as the justification for non-closing gaps, with each such gap (multi-session, residual leak, no auto-refresh) explicitly documented rather than implicit? [Ambiguity, Spec §Edge Cases/§Assumptions]
